mainnetRulesPoh: Nothing accrues without proof of humanity: no founder points on testnet and no personal PPL rewards on mainnet until your account is verified and your wallet is linked.
mainnetRulesVestingBullets: On mainnet day one, 10% of your converted personal reward unlocks immediately (verified founders only).
The remaining 90% unlocks in equal weekly slices over exactly 12 months.

Each calendar month you need at least one qualifying on-chain or Project feed action. If a month passes with no activity, weekly unlocking pauses until you return — missed weeks are not skipped forward.
Testnet activity points are separate; they inform conversion but these unlock rules apply to PPL on mainnet.
mainnetRulesSaleFeeBody: When you sell unlocked PPL during the first 30 days after the network launches, a fee is withheld in PPL from the sale: 10% on day one, falling linearly to 0% on day 30. The fee goes to the community pool.
mainnetRulesStakingBullets: Optional stake adds +25% to the validator reward rate — a bonus on the rate, not 25% of your stake amount, and not a promise of any specific yield.
Staking rewards are paid from the community pool and unlock on the same weekly schedule as your personal reward.
Unstaking has a 21-day waiting period before PPL returns to your wallet.
